name: Dessign

sources.title: Homepage — curated AI tools directory (est. 2010, WordPress-powered), claims ~50k monthly visitors
Submit page — paid only: $69 Featured listing or $399 Pro (newsletter+social+blog post); 'We are no longer offering free submissions'

requirements: AI tool or software product fitting their categories (AI agents, design, dev tools, SaaS, SEO, video, writing, etc.)
Paid only: $69 one-time Featured listing (was $129) or $399 one-time Pro (adds newsletter feature to 40k subscribers, 1500-word blog post, listicle, social posts)
Payment via Stripe payment links on the submit page
preparation: Product name, URL, description, and target category
For Pro: assets for the newsletter feature and social posts
workflow: Provide product details; listing goes live in 1-2 business days (1 day for Pro)
Full refund if the product isn't published
watchFor: Free submissions are discontinued — any older doc claiming a free route is stale
DR80/50k-visitor/40k-subscriber figures are site self-claims; verify value before paying $399
Listings are permanent ('never expire') per FAQ
Newsletter is monthly, sent at the start of each month — Pro feature timing depends on that cycle
countsAsLive: The product has a public page under dessign.net/<slug>/ linked from a category listing
unknowns: What information the post-payment intake collects (form behind Stripe checkout)
Whether the dofollow link is site-wide or per-page
